static_review.capture_owner: BoardDialogueJobs copies the capture snapshot into the submitted job. The provider closes over that job and reads with its exact meta on the sole CPU worker.
static_review.face_freshness: build_visual compares capture-boundary boot/service/camera/target/revision/single-face evidence. Worker checks current job after readback and source_end age below 3000ms.
static_review.face_reference: gallery(reference,meta,observed_visual) requires matching captured identity and gallery revision before a face naming proof.
static_review.source_guards: Production FaceGalleryReadback verifies pinned boot/process/source/config/model and uses readonly SQLite with a 30ms busy timeout.
static_review.locking: New provider runs outside the service RLock on the existing single worker. Health/cancel remained available during a blocked public provider.
static_review.model_text: Existing full synthetic tests verify fabricated model-success text creates no enrollment/link/profile capability.
static_review.complete_ack: Candidate changes are confined to the three reviewed identity sources; ordinary and identity pipeline tests retain their actual complete ACK entry points.

limitations: Public synthetic fixtures execute the actual board business and SQLite guard paths with fake encoder and inference transport.
Actual face and voice accuracy and actual gallery IO duration are unmeasured in this local review.

The existing single worker serializes explicit identity commands behind in-flight analysis; slow filesystem reads can add queue delay. SQLite lock waits are bounded at 30ms, total filesystem reads are not preempted.
Current-production pin merge, source freshness and release execution remain owned by root.
